Truckload privacy notice

Draft notice — November 3, 2026. This notice describes the current local-only edition. It must be reviewed and updated before public App Store release or any server-side collection.

Information you enter

Truckload lets you enter trip routes, load payment, expenses, fuel purchases, truck settings, business costs and rate-confirmation documents. These records are currently saved in storage on the device/browser where you use Truckload. They are not automatically uploaded to a Truckload cloud account.

Documents and third-party resources

Document reading happens in the app/browser. OCR and PDF components may download software resources from third-party content delivery networks when needed. Network requests may expose standard connection information such as IP address to those providers. Do not upload documents containing unnecessary personal, financial or payment-card details.

Account and subscription availability

Cloud accounts, cross-device synchronization and Apple subscriptions are not currently active. No account or subscription information is collected through those features in this edition.

Data retention and deletion

Local data stays on your device until you delete it, clear application/browser storage, or uninstall the app. Use Account & privacy → Delete my data on this device to remove Truckload's local records and saved documents. Exports and copies outside Truckload are not affected. Cloud account deletion will be available if and when cloud accounts launch.

Support contact

You may email antoinettewilliams@thetruelavender.online with questions or requests about information you previously sent through support. Email messages are transmitted through your email provider and are not covered by the local-only storage description above.

Changes

This notice will be updated before introducing account registration, cloud synchronization, analytics, additional third-party services or subscriptions. Review the published policy for the current edition before submitting sensitive information.
